summary_1line: Sakuni and Karna persuade Duryodhana to visit the exiled Pandavas in the forest to gloat over their misery and display his prosperity.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a royal chamber, Sakuni and Karna lean close to Duryodhana, whispering a scheme while the troubled prince sits on his throne.
A richly adorned Duryodhana imagines himself riding in splendor toward the forest where the Pandavas dwell in bark garments beside a lonely lake.
Draupadi stands in rough bark clothing in the wilderness while, in Duryodhana's vision, his jeweled queen approaches in dazzling ornaments.
